connector_contracts.label: User-owned devices and apps
connector_contracts.minimum_scope: observe or draft first; one approved action at a time

connector_contracts.label: Business databases
connector_contracts.minimum_scope: read-only selected schemas and views first

connector_contracts.label: Servers and infrastructure
connector_contracts.minimum_scope: health and telemetry read access first

platform_profiles.label: GitHub
platform_profiles.recommended_identity: GitHub App installed only on selected repositories
platform_profiles.write_policy: Request contents or pull-request write access only for an exact approved task; no administration scope by default.

platform_profiles.label: User-owned computer or mobile device
platform_profiles.recommended_identity: loopback-only local bridge with an ephemeral session token
platform_profiles.write_policy: No arbitrary clicks, typing, credential entry, protected settings, or destructive commands.

platform_profiles.label: Documented app or API
platform_profiles.recommended_identity: restricted service identity with a vault reference
platform_profiles.write_policy: Pass schema, timeout, retry, rate-limit, audit, and sandbox tests before any live write.

secret_stores.label: Environment variable
secret_stores.resolution_boundary: A deployed backend resolves the named environment entry; public pages never receive the value.

secret_stores.label: macOS Keychain
secret_stores.resolution_boundary: The authenticated loopback bridge writes one owner-approved value and returns only its locator.

secret_stores.label: Managed vault
secret_stores.resolution_boundary: A scoped backend identity resolves and rotates the entry without returning its value to public clients.
